recommended_plugin.purpose: Coordinate long-running agentic software-development projects through project-local memory, preflight intake, continuous-run slices, status handoff, and plugin-improvement review.
recommended_plugin.install_status: installed and enabled for future Codex threads
recommended_plugin.created_from: Project-local readiness contract and accepted decision matrix; project-specific rows were not packaged as defaults.

skills.responsibility: Normalize user intent, referred specs, and archetype-specific questions into a project-local intent packet and readiness gate.
skills.mutation_boundary: Writes project-local intent, readiness, queue, resource, authority, and supervision artifacts only.

skills.responsibility: Run continuous delivery with coordinator-owned slice queue, worker dispatch, validation, blockers, run-state, handoff, incident logs, and branch ledger.
skills.mutation_boundary: May edit project code, docs, tests, fixtures, and coordinator-owned project-local control artifacts inside active authority.

skills.responsibility: Read project-local memory and generate status summaries, run-state artifacts, handoff digests, dashboard handoff data, incident summaries, and user-return presentations.
skills.mutation_boundary: Read-only against project implementation except generated reports and presentations.

skills.responsibility: Review project-local plugin-improvement candidates and prepare explicit plugin-development recommendations.
skills.mutation_boundary: May write candidate analysis and queues; cannot edit plugin files unless explicit plugin-development work has started.

shared_assets: schemas for intent packets, authority ledgers, accepted decision matrices, slice queues, worker reports, incident logs, external capabilities, result packets, dashboards, run-state, and handoff digests
semantic HTML templates for human review surfaces
helper scripts for rendering run-state, handoff digest, incident log, and bounded dashboard data when target projects lack local implementations
archetype registry defaults with project-local override support

optional_components.policy: Omit from plugin.json unless a companion .mcp.json is actually created during explicit plugin-development work.
Omit from plugin.json unless a companion .app.json is actually created during explicit plugin-development work.
Do not put unsupported hooks fields in plugin.json; use only validator-supported manifest fields.

project_artifact_sources.plugin_candidate: accepted decision matrix schema and template
project_artifact_sources.treatment: Generalized in skill guidance and shared contract; current rows were not packaged as defaults.

project_artifact_sources.plugin_candidate: slice queue schema and status-lane model
project_artifact_sources.treatment: Generalize schema, status values, lease fields, and four-lane summaries.
Generalize metadata-only event types and HIPAA-aware reminders; do not include PHI or secrets.
Generalize connection metadata, authority, credential-source metadata, and supervision boundaries.
Generalize datasets for optional external visualization; do not hard-code a dashboard renderer.
Generalize overlay mechanism; current project overlays remain project-local examples.

exclusions: Do not package Agentic Wiki repo-specific decisions as plugin defaults.
Do not package user chat history, credentials, secret values, PHI, generated run logs, project queue state, or project-specific accepted decision rows.
Do not package BMAD as a dependency; keep BMAD as one storage adapter when _bmad exists.
Do not include Cloudflare-specific deployment assumptions.
Do not create marketplace entries, plugin folders, cachebusters, or plugin installs until explicit plugin-development work starts.

scaffold_sequence_for_later_explicit_wor.notes: Completed with local-use metadata, no TODO placeholders, and no apps or mcpServers.
Deferred; use only after a later local iteration changes the installed plugin.

scaffold_sequence_for_later_explicit_wor.command: Start a new Codex thread in a disposable BMAD project and a disposable non-BMAD project.
scaffold_sequence_for_later_explicit_wor.notes: Pending; requires a new Codex thread so newly installed skills are loaded.

acceptance_tests: Plugin manifest validates with plugin-creator validate_plugin.py.
A fresh thread sees the plugin skills after reinstall.
Intake/preflight can create intent packet, authority ledger, accepted decision matrix, and readiness gate artifacts in a BMAD project.
Intake/preflight can create equivalent artifacts in a non-BMAD lightweight Agentic Wiki memory root.
Continuous coordinator can create a slice queue with status lanes, leases, and validation commands without touching plugin files.
Status/handoff can render run-state and handoff digest from slice queue.
Incident log and PHI-aware monitoring templates stay metadata-only with no PHI or secret values.
External capability registry and result packets record connection presence and evidence without credentials.
Project overlays can alter project-local guidance without changing plugin defaults.
Dashboard handoff data remains bounded and can be delegated to external visualization tools when requested.
